mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 65 degrees with slight rain at Badger Prairie County Park, and the moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is reaching out about important cross connection inspections to protect our water supply, and don't forget that road construction on Highway M will be impacting traffic with detours through October 9.
There is a lot going on to kick off the month, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Art Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia, all happening today.
In recent police reports, a retail theft involving candy occurred on September 21, where the subject was identified through surveillance footage and later cited.
You can satisfy your cravings with today's flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you can head over to the store when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
